title: One core, connected subsystems.
lede: DIBIA is the processor: shared methods, review, and infrastructure. Each venture plugs into it like a subsystem on a motherboard, the same way the SpatialSENSai paper describes context sensing as a portable layer that any XR app can plug into.
ariaLabel: Diagram: the DIBIA chip connected to SpatialSENSai, sudo / Aperture and DigiGreenBookZ, with open sockets for Third Place and DigiDinar

subsystems.name: SpatialSENSai
subsystems.blurb: A drop-in context layer for XR apps. Its engine, ContextLogger, reads gaze, head motion and scene signals on-device and returns a privacy-preserving context stream.

subsystems.name: sudo / Aperture
subsystems.blurb: A universal remote for shared spatial interaction. Our entry for the IEEE VR 2027 3DUI Contest.

subsystems.name: DigiGreenBookZ
subsystems.blurb: A trip builder for travel planning. We use it to plan our own trips while we build it.

later.name: DigiDinar
later.blurb: a ledger for trust and contribution across the collective.
